servers.description: MCP server that gives Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients access to a Zotero library: search, citations, adding items, safe writes, semantic search, PDF passages and page images.

servers.name: Ztds Mcp
servers.description: Open standard MCP server for Zero-Trust Data Sanitization (ZTDS RFC v1.0). In-memory PII masking.

servers.name: Zumen
servers.description: AI-editable diagrams as code: an AI agent draws from YAML via MCP (Claude Code and others), a human fixes the layout, and the fix survives regeneration. Renders SVG; exports Mermaid and draw.io.
